Why it’s different

Three things most desk lamps get wrong — fixed.

1

No flicker, no glare

DC-driven LED with a frosted dome diffuser. No visible flicker on camera, no hot spot on glossy paper or screens.

2

It remembers you

Memory dimmer returns to your last brightness and temperature every time. One tap for reading, hold for night mode.

3

One cable, any desk

USB-C powered with clamp or weighted base included in the box. No brick, no proprietary charger to lose.

Made for long evenings

From first draft
to last page.

2700K–5000K in a single turn. Start warm while you sketch, shift cooler when you need to concentrate, and let the auto-off timer handle the rest when you finally close the notebook.

  • Auto-off timer — 30 / 60 / 120 minutes
  • Arm reaches 58 cm, folds to 6 cm flat
  • Touch dimmer with audible-free, step-less control

Questions

Does it work with a monitor light bar setup?

Yes — the Arc sits behind or beside a monitor without competing for the USB port; it runs from any USB-C charger or power bank (12W+).

Clamp or base — do I choose at checkout?

Both are in the box. Use the weighted base on glass or delicate desks, the clamp everywhere else. No tools needed either way.

What if the LED fails?

The light module is replaceable under the 3-year warranty — you don’t replace the whole lamp.

The Lumen Arc Desk Lamp

Light, exactly where your thoughts land.

A lamp that follows the work — not the other way round. This is the long version: how it moves, how it warms, and why it’s built to be repaired instead of replaced.

$129$169Buy on Amazon →Read the story ↓
★★★★★ 4.8 · 1,284 ratings · 94% would recommend
✓ Free delivery✓ 30-day returns✓ 3-year warranty✓ USB-C powered
01

Light that follows you

Most lamps light a circle. The Arc lights a workspace. Its counter-balanced arm glides with one finger — over a sketchbook, across to a keyboard, down low for reading — and stays exactly where you leave it, night after night, with no droop and no tools.

The dome is deliberately wide: 800 lumens spread evenly, so your hand doesn’t cast a shadow over the line you’re writing.

02

Warm to focused, in one turn

The brass dial at the base does two jobs: turn for brightness, press-and-turn for temperature. Mornings get a crisp 5000K that makes paper look white. Evenings settle to 2700K — the colour of a good reading room.

2700K · Warm3800K · Neutral5000K · Focus
“I stopped noticing the lamp — and started noticing the work. That’s the highest praise I can give a tool.”
— MAYA R. · VERIFIED PURCHASE · ★★★★★
03

Built to be repaired, not replaced

Every joint is screwed, not glued. The LED module, cable and dial are replaceable parts — listed, priced, and shippable in a padded envelope. Aluminium and brass, chosen because they age well and recycle cleanly.
